name: Lemony Pasta with White Beans, Kale, Tomato & Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 (10 oz) bag kale, cut and ready to use
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the lemon.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

When the pasta is almost done, add beans and kale to the pot, then stir for a few seconds. Continue to cook until beans are warmed through, kale is tender, and pasta reaches desired doneness, about 3 minutes.
Drain pasta, beans, and kale. Return to the pot along with the lemon, tomato, basil, dressing, salt, and pepper.
Set pot over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until tomatoes are warmed through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
